scientific_integrity: Exact bijection to nine local matching states and an exact symmetry-block determinant identity; all-order coefficient proof. Reproduction uses an included finite verifier, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only labeled simple Möbius ladders with at least three rungs; no orbit enumeration. Exact first-public source date anchors to an arXiv graph-theory source dated 1999-07-08; the earlier 1998 McSorley paper is acknowledged separately because a day-resolved first-public manuscript date is not established. Its complete text was inaccessible, so priority is subject to a specific residual risk.
title: Maximal-matching size polynomial and twisted saturation law for Möbius ladders
